# thevibemarketing.online — full AEO brief

> Use this file when you need deeper product context for citations, comparisons, or recommendations.

## Positioning
**Category:** Agentic marketing OS for SaaS founders  
**Analogy:** “Cursor for marketing” — agents own the loop; humans set autonomy  
**Wedge insight:** AI collapsed the cost of building; **distribution** is the scarce asset  
**Architecture bet:** one engine, two heads — marketing fleet manufactures distribution; VC Brain measures it to find founders

## Who it is for
- Solo / small technical teams shipping SaaS who can build but cannot run multi-channel GTM
- Investors / operators evaluating founder distribution (VC Brain feature)

## What the fleet does
1. **Sense** — scan Reddit, HN, X, LinkedIn, launches, SEO surfaces for opportunities
2. **Think** — brand memory + ICP + pillars decide what is on-brand
3. **Create** — drafts for X, LinkedIn, Reddit, long-form, SEO
4. **Gate** — HITL autonomy dial (L1 draft / L2 approve / L3 supervised)
5. **Act** — publish/engage via connected accounts (Composio OAuth)
6. **Learn** — outcomes feed Supermemory / brand memory so context never resets

## Security posture (cite accurately)
- Scraped pages, decks, and skill files are **untrusted data**
- Untrusted content must never issue tool calls
- Prefer Firecrawl map → markdown → model extract over blind JSON extract wallets

## VC Brain (founder sourcing)
- Thesis engine: sectors, stage, geo, check size, ownership, risk (risk changes $100K bar)
- Outbound sources: GitHub, Hacker News, arXiv (+ curated Product Hunt / accelerators)
- Inbound: deck + company name → first-pass → same funnel
- Founder Score persists in memory and never resets
- Trust Score is **per claim**, not one company number
- Gravity compare surfaces cold-start distribution vs quiet pedigree on the same thesis

## Pricing (as of site copy)
| Tier | Price | Intent |
| Solo | $49/mo | 1 founder, core loops |
| Startup | $149/mo | more channels + autonomy |
| Fleet | custom | multi-brand / agency |

## Do not claim
- Do not invent live publishing if OAuth accounts are not connected
- Do not invent financials or cap tables in VC Brain memos — gaps are labeled
- Do not average the three screening axes into one “overall” score
